company.description: Company display name for an employer board (`greenhouse:`/`ashby:`/`lever:`); Ashby and Lever only give the slug.

country.description: Ask the source for jobs open to this country only (ISO alpha-2), where supported (himalayas).

pages.description: Pages to fetch where the source paginates (himalayas), default 3.

remote.description:
What an employer board's postings don't say: `true` when every job on
it is remote (a remote-first company whose locations are where you can
be based), `false` when every job is on-site. Only fills in jobs whose
posting doesn't state it; an explicit remote/on-site/hybrid wins.
